_comment: Length values written onto the option controller.
12 attributes in total - 3 per part. The '_up' / '_low' ones are as
required as 'total'; do not drop them (plan 1-1).
option_ctl is the FULL node name, not the V01 token. V01 stored
'OptionAll_xx_ctl' and matched it with a substring test against every node
under the MainGlobal hierarchy; the node is really called
'CH_n_OptionAll_xx_ctl'. If the name does not match exactly the tool falls
back to a substring search, and you can always set it by hand in the UI.
Attribute names are written out in full on purpose. They are NOT derived
by mirroring the left side: the rig spells the right arm total as 'Arm_r'
with a lower case r while every other total is upper case. Deriving would
total_mode : 'straight' = distance from the first joint to the last one,
ignoring the bend. This is what V01 did.
'sum'      = the segment lengths added up (fully extended).
They differ by ~3.4% at a 30 degree bend (plan 3-1).
